description.en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance.

description.zh:
加速区域接入模式，取值如下：

- anycast：查询支持的anycast加速地域
- 其它值：查询支持的非anycast加速地域
description.en:
The access mode of the acceleration area. Valid values:

- anycast: queries the supported anycast acceleration areas.

- Other values: queries the supported non-anycast acceleration areas.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-available-accelerate-areas --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1yeeq8yfoyszmqy0000 --access-mode anycast --region cn-hangzhou
